description: Create, delete, and protect branches and tags. Actions: create_branch (from ref), delete_branch, protect_branch (set allowed roles), unprotect_branch, update_branch_protection, create_tag (annotated or lightweight), delete_tag, protect_tag, unprotect_tag. Related: browse_refs for inspection.

action.description: Action to perform: create_branch, delete_branch, protect_branch, unprotect_branch, update_branch_protection, create_tag, delete_tag, protect_tag, unprotect_tag

allow_force_push.description: Allow force push to protected branch (default: false) Required for 'protect_branch', 'update_branch_protection' action(s).

allowed_to_create.description: Granular create access (Premium feature) Required for 'protect_tag' action(s).

allowed_to_merge.description: Granular merge access (Premium feature) Required for 'protect_branch', 'update_branch_protection' action(s).

allowed_to_push.description: Granular push access (Premium feature) Required for 'protect_branch', 'update_branch_protection' action(s).

allowed_to_unprotect.description: Granular unprotect access (Premium feature) Required for 'protect_branch', 'update_branch_protection' action(s).

branch.description: Name for the new branch Required for 'create_branch', 'delete_branch' action(s).

code_owner_approval_required.description: Require code owner approval (Premium feature) Required for 'protect_branch', 'update_branch_protection' action(s).

create_access_level.description: Who can create matching tags (default: 40=Maintainers) Required for 'protect_tag' action(s).

merge_access_level.description: Who can merge (default: 40=Maintainers) Required for 'protect_branch' action(s).

message.description: Annotation message (creates annotated tag if provided) Required for 'create_tag' action(s).

name.description: Branch name or wildcard pattern (e.g., 'main', 'release-*') Required for 'protect_branch', 'unprotect_branch', 'update_branch_protection', 'protect_tag', 'unprotect_tag' action(s).

push_access_level.description: Who can push (default: 40=Maintainers) Required for 'protect_branch' action(s).

ref.description: Source branch name, tag, or commit SHA to create from Required for 'create_branch', 'create_tag' action(s).

tag_name.description: Name for the new tag (e.g., 'v1.0.0') Required for 'create_tag', 'delete_tag' action(s).

unprotect_access_level.description: Who can unprotect (default: 40=Maintainers) Required for 'protect_branch' action(s).

name: manage_ref
